heardSemantics: Refines the stop-report prototype (a WeakSet marked by any frame an active binding consumed). A transport counts as heard only while every sequenced campaign frame it has dispatched was consumed by an active binding of this consumer: the consumer records transport.lastSeq() after each campaign frame an active binding consumes (WeakMap keyed by transport identity), and a rebind arms the window unless a record exists and equals transport.lastSeq(). A first frame that arrives while no binding is mounted is not remembered (no record), and a sequenced frame that arrives during an unmount gap moves lastSeq past the record, so both re-arm the window exactly as P2CG1F always did: the continued lineage never folded that frame, so recovery through the window is the conservative behaviour. The prototype WeakSet would have skipped the window in the second case
